selection: frozen multi-source validation subset max2000/source/class; eight-class macro-F1, same subset for both arms
sampling: uniform shuffled full pass with cyclic carry; every training sample visited before stopping
comparison: same eight outputs, optimizer and number of draws per round; not old seven-output weights
filter: retain user 50Hz Q30 notch plus bidirectional .5-40Hz bandpass
test: frozen until training all arms/seeds complete; old test cohorts already used historically, not pristine external evidence
